scope: Independent read-only source review; no browser/GPU runtime while live LAAS reference captures are active
baselineStatus: before-r2 is an interrupted llvmpipe software diagnostic, status.complete=false; not a valid hardware baseline

verified.result: All five new states satisfy world bounds, pitch 0.05..1.05, zoom 4..18 and flight height 0..44; Node imported transpiled pure layout modules without browser.
quality branch sets ordinary player/input/weather; existing updateCamera(1,true) resets interpolation at setState end. No private visual-only camera position is used.
Software detector and performanceValid=false are honored; method describes rAF intervals rather than GPU-only timing.
Current script records poseDrift and rejects >0.05 m; hardware runtime still required to prove no pushes/camera relocation.
Selected sourceMap.sourcesContent must byte-match files. Server responses and omitted dependencies are not covered by current sourceMapMatch claim.

findings.description: The real-input landing waits only for flying=false before capturing landed diagnostics, but movePlayer exponentially lowers y with a 12/s factor after F. At descent gate <3m the character is still around 2.7m above terrain, so immediate landed sample fails final <0.1m grounding assertion even when gameplay is correct.
findings.fix: Wait for !flying AND player speed settled AND |y-ground| <= 0.08 before sampling. Also settle walk/road samples before their static grounding assertions.

findings.description: Active performance page.evaluate returns a Promise resolved only after rAF samples and has no host deadline. A stalled or background-throttled page can hang the process forever rather than closing browser and recording a failed stage.
findings.fix: Use a bounded host-side deadline that also covers evaluate stalls, persist failure status, and close browser in finally.

findings.description: Source-map comparison hashes local dist, but capture URL can serve a different build or a dev server. Runtime evidence is not bound to builtHashes, so sourceMapMatch=true cannot establish that the captured page was the exact verified build.
findings.fix: Hash served main JS/module responses against local dist bundle hashes, or use a build-ID generated into both local metadata and runtime diagnostics and verify it before capture.

findings.description: status.json is created only after mkdir, manifest, source reads and stale-build checks, and later exceptions leave only complete=false without phase/state/reason. Failed hooks/real input may leave no corresponding diagnostic JSON or screenshot.
findings.fix: Initialize status at stage start and persist a catch result including phase/current state/error; preserve partial evidence and do not mark complete.

coverageLimits.detail: 8m forest walk, vertical flight ascent/descent, a right-drag orbit and one 3m road movement are useful smoke evidence only. They do not prove full road net width, camera collision against rock/trees, arbitrary exploration, save compatibility or LOD/motion stability.
For current layout index 73, KeyA is 0.9947 aligned downhill along the road, cross-road component 0.1027; grade=0.1968. It tests a short centreline move, not the whole width.
Current active/frozen gate compares player position only. Camera position and target are recorded but not compared. Inspect them in hardware run before calling states repeatable.
NVIDIA verification is parent-reported external evidence. This reviewer did not launch a browser, so hardware per-state runtime remains unverified here.

reReview.scope: Read-only re-review after fixes; no GPU/browser runtime
verifiedFixes: Walk and road wait speed<0.1 and |y-ground|<0.05 before snapshots. Landing waits !flying and |y-ground|<0.05.
Active rAF page.evaluate races against 60000ms host deadline.
Actual served /assets/*.js response bodies are SHA-256 matched to builtHashes and persisted in provenance.
Terminal failures inside runtime try/catch persist String(error).
realInputSmokeComplete and scope text explicitly limit smoke claims.

remainingFindings.description: Exclusive stage directory creation, evidence manifest writes, source/build reads, map freshness validation, source/status writes and Chromium launch remain outside runtime try/catch. A stale build fails before status.json exists; launch failure leaves complete=false without terminal error.
remainingFindings.fix: After exclusive mkdir succeeds, initialize status then wrap remaining preflight, launch and runtime in one catch/finally; conditionally close browser when assigned.

remainingCoverageLimits: No GPU/browser runtime was run by reviewer. Verify hardware pose stability and source.json servedHashes in final stage.
Grounded player drift is asserted but camera drift is only recorded; inspect camera/target equality before calling states stable.
Smoke scope remains correct; actual full-road and collision/free-exploration acceptance requires broader checks.

finalReview.scope: Independent read-only source review after final outer try/catch repair; no browser/GPU runtime
finalReview.verdict: No remaining concrete source blockers within requested capture-module scope
evidence: Exclusive mkdir refuses reusing an existing evidence directory. Initial status is written before guarded preflight.
Manifest/source reads/source-map exactness/build provenance/Chromium launch/runtime work are all inside outer try/catch.
Any guarded preflight or runtime error records complete=false, terminal=true and String(error). finally uses browser?.close(), so launch failure does not mask the original failure.
Original LandQualityViews.ts/Game.ts QA branch remains unchanged from prior review; all five ordinary input limits remain valid.
remainingRuntimeChecks: Hardware baseline per-state capture/pose stability/JS hashes and input smoke are now evidenced below. Broader full-road, collisions, free exploration, save compatibility, LOD/motion and aesthetic quality gates remain open.
finalReview.provenanceLimits: This module binds captured JS responses to local dist JS and selected source maps. Served public GLB/assets were unchanged by this module; they are not rehashed by this script.

realInput.scope: Smoke: forest walk, vertical sword flight, mouse orbit, landing, 3m road movement. Does not prove full road-width or collision/free-exploration acceptance.

sectPose.limits: Inside world bounds; pitch and distance on legal min/max boundaries; flight height equals legal max 44m.

sectImageAssessment.baselineFraming: Accepted for inspecting main mountain and sect skyline: temple complex clearly rises on the central summit and the mountain cliff mass/road traverses are visible. Previous foot-view occlusion is resolved.
limitations: Much upper frame is sky and right frame is ocean; the mountain base is partly clipped/covered by the existing HUD.
This view exposes smooth broad cliff slabs, repeated narrow rock spires, weak ecological canopy and empty ridge shoulders. These are baseline defects, not accepted target quality.
Camera is an ordinary maximum-height sword-flight viewpoint above the western side mountain; it does not prove a ground-level sect panorama or free exploration correctness.

hardwareBaselineReview.verdict: Hardware capture evidence and honest main-mountain/sect baseline framing now adequate for this module; whole goal quality remains unachieved.
